mapper.insert: INSERT INTO orders (user_id, buy_at, total_amount, status, coupon_id) VALUES (#{userId}, CURRENT_DATE, #{totalAmount}, false, #{couponId})
INSERT INTO order_items (order_id, product_id, quantity) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{cart.productId}, #{cart.quantity})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM coupons WHERE id IN (SELECT id FROM coupons_users WHERE user_id = #{userId})
SELECT id, user_id, buy_at, total_amount, status, coupon_id FROM orders WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY id ASC
SELECT id, user_id, buy_at, total_amount, status, coupon_id FROM orders WHERE id = #{orderId}

SELECT oi.product_id, oi.quantity, p.name, p.price, pi.image_path AS imagePath FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id LEFT JOIN product_images pi ON pi.id = ( SELECT MIN(id) FROM product_images WHERE product_id = oi.product_id ) WHERE oi.order_id = #{orderId}
